title: Kompetenzbrille Competency Framework
description: Schema for competency framework data files (data/frameworks/*.yaml). A framework declares phases of a data-related process, evaluation dimensions, and competencies that combine a phase with per-dimension descriptions. The same schema applies to JSON-LD serializations (see framework-context.jsonld).

@context.description: Optional JSON-LD @context. When present, the document is simultaneously valid JSON-LD (see data/schemas/framework-context.jsonld).

@id.description: Optional JSON-LD node identifier (IRI) of the framework.

id.description: Stable identifier of the framework; referenced by study-program mappings via their 'framework' property.

version.description: Framework version (e.g. "4"). Keep as a string to avoid type coercion.

language.description: Locale of this file (the DE/EN files are locales of the same framework).

source.description: Source document, as a path relative to the app root (e.g. assets/….pdf) or an absolute URL.

doi.description: Persistent identifier of the framework document.

orientation.description: Prior knowledge ('Orientierungswissen') that lies outside the data flow and forms the foundation of all phases.

languageTag.description: BCP 47 language tag (ISO 639-1 two-letter codes suffice here).

code.description: Short code such as "1.1" — quote it in YAML so it stays a string, not a float.

anyOf.description: IRI form, as emitted by scripts/yaml-to-jsonld.js.

ref.description: Node reference: literal id (YAML form) or IRI (JSON-LD form).

anyOf.description: IRI form, as emitted by scripts/yaml-to-jsonld.js.

codeRef.description: Competency reference: literal code (YAML form) or IRI (JSON-LD form).

text.description: Optional phase description (e.g. the content of the 'Orientierungswissen' phase 0).

note.description: Optional note (e.g. that phase 0 lies outside the data flow and forms the foundation of all phases).

competency.description: A competency. 'code' + 'phase' + 'title' are structural; every other property is a dimension row whose key must match a declared dimension id (e.g. knowledge, skills, examples).

phase.description: Must reference one of the declared phase ids (literal id or IRI).

$comment2: Cross-file constraints not expressible in JSON Schema alone: each competency.phase must equal some phases[].id; each competency dimension-row key must equal some dimensions[].id; all data-localized strings are in the language given by 'language'.
